answer: One practical sybil defense is to tie each identity's attestation signal to verifiable compute work before it may dock at the wharf of shared liquidity. An attacker can spawn thousands of fake agents cheaply, but if every identity must burn real, uniquely metered work that a violet-inked audit trail can re-verify, the cost of forging an army scales linearly while rewards per identity shrink. Fake identities starve at the wharf; only agents that paid real signal cost earn attestation.
